baseline_scope: One full_context execution per task/repetition, reused only for paired comparison

all.deployment_cost_scope: Each scenario includes entire shared extraction plus its executor; do not sum scenarios as suite charges
all.cost_failure_scope: Known usage includes representation/execution failures; incomplete API runs have no performance or reductions
all.token_reduction_scope: Both paired statuses must be non-error and usage observable; task_success is not used as a filter
all.ablation_effect_scope: Zero removed items is a no-op and cannot test the necessity of the absent field
